data.title: 佐天泪子 · 沙滩排球网前双手抱球跃跃欲试的活力大笑
data.action: 单脚踩在松软的金黄沙滩上，两手抱在一颗红白蓝相间的沙滩排球旁，擦去额头晶莹汗珠，大笑着向前招手
data.location: 学园都市人工海滨度假区热闹非凡的沙滩排球场
data.lighting: 盛夏海滨明快透亮的大晴天，万里无云，强烈的日光在健康紧致的少女雪肤与排球上洒满金色活力
data.camera: medium full shot, low angle, wide energetic framing, youthful dynamic anime style
data.mood: 充满生机、豪爽元气与无所畏惧的青春活力
data.description: 海风带起细碎的金色砂砾。佐天泪子一身亮黄色扶桑花比基尼，长黑发上别着的纯白花朵在夏风里格外鲜活。她单手抱住沙滩排球，另一手抬起抹掉额角的汗珠，朝着场边遮阳伞下的初春和御坂学姐大声欢呼——「初春！御坂学姐！快来快来，接下来的双人排球赛就要开始了！输的人要请大家吃超大份宇治金时刨冰哦！本大爷可是绝对不会手下留情的！」
data.promptProse: Saten Ruiko stands energetically on a golden sand volleyball court in her bright yellow hibiscus-print bikini, clutching a beach volleyball with an open, spirited laugh under clear morning skies. Dazzling midsummer sunlight sparkles across the school pool surface, throwing lively turquoise caustic reflections across her cheerful summer pose.
data.animaCaption: Endless azure summer skies and salty sea spray ignite the Level 0 maiden's unstoppable, vibrant enthusiasm. Dazzling midsummer sunlight sparkles across the school pool surface, throwing lively turquoise caustic reflections across her cheerful summer pose.
